log naming modes
tabperiod opens one log per table stamped with the period start
tabular opens one log per table stamped with the day start
singular opens one shared log stamped with the day start
periodic opens one shared log stamped with the period start
tables in a singular log share one handle
custom opens logs under each table's own mode
batch modes and updates
immediate logs and publishes every update
defaultbatch logs straight away and publishes on the flush with counts pending until then
memorybatch buffers then logs the whole buffer as one message on the flush
updates are timestamped unless already stamped and table and multi-table messages are accepted
a string table name from a feed is accepted as the symbol
errmode diverts failed updates to the error log as upderr messages
without errmode an update for an unknown table throws back to the feed

a custom-mode table missing from the csv publishes without a log (fix 9)
